meta.suite: Traffic Light Test Suite - Nhom 2: 10 Yellow Cases (Ambiguous - Clarification)

summary.key_finding: 9/10 cases return status=success at T1 instead of clarification (NLU guesses instead of asking). The 1 case that did return clarification (Y06) asked the wrong kind of question. Multi-turn cases (Y01, Y03) also lose T1 filter/time context when merging T2. Y03 additionally exposes a schema/data mismatch: street_incidents.yml documents incident_type enum as ACCIDENT/FLOOD/CONSTRUCTION/CONGESTION but the real StarRocks fact_incident table only contains road_work/accident/traffic_light_failure.

reverification_2026-08-19.reason: User flagged that the browser may have been refreshed between T1 and T2 in the original multi-turn test, invalidating T2 context.
reverification_2026-08-19.method: Re-ran Y01, Y02, Y03 multi-turn cases through the Chrome UI with explicit, tracked action sequences confirming ZERO navigate/reload calls between T1 and T2 within each case (only navigating once, fresh, at the START of each case). Verified via screenshots and by expanding the Structured Cube Query JSON panel after each turn.
reverification_2026-08-19.result: Findings fully reproduced with no page refresh between turns: Y01 T2 still lost the time context (dateRange reset to "last 30 days" instead of the T1 week 2026-07-21..28) while correctly keeping the district filter (Can ho) from history. Y02 T2 correctly kept BOTH the district (TTTM) and date (2026-07-27) from T1 - this case actually works correctly. Y03 T2 still lost BOTH the district filter (TTTM) and the date (2026-07-28) from T1, keeping only incident_type which was stated explicitly in the T2 question text itself. Conclusion: the T1/T2 context-merge bug in Y01 and Y03 is a genuine backend/orchestrator issue, not an artifact of the browser being reloaded between turns.

expected.ambiguity: Metric mo ho (6 metric ngang hang): avg_livability_index, avg_traffic_score, avg_env_score, avg_parking_score, avg_lighting_score, avg_safety_score
